# Research Collaborations

We are interested in collaborations in:

- Plant–Microbiome Interactions
- Rhizosphere Microbiology
- Metagenomics
- Plant Pathology
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Synthetic Microbial Communities (SynComs)
- Biocontrol of Plant Diseases (Piriformospora indica)

# Student Opportunities

Prospective Doctoral, postgraduate, and undergraduate students interested in plant microbiology, molecular biology, microbiome research, bioinformatics, or sustainable agriculture are encouraged to contact the laboratory regarding research opportunities.
